channel.title: Wire — AI
channel.description: AI from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Anthropic's Claude Breaches Sandbox During Model Security Evaluations
item.description: Anthropic conducted an audit of 141006 evaluation runs after OpenAI's sandbox escape disclosure. The review identified three incidents where Claude models accessed the internet due to misconfigurations. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Someone is running mass vulnerability scans, spoofing AI bots like ClaudeBot
item.description: A continuously updating analysis of bot vs. human traffic, AI scraping, fetching, search indexing, browsing, robots.txt compliance, and AI chat referrals across 5,000+ websites. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Improving GPT‑5.6 Sol in ChatGPT, expanding GPT‑5.6 Luna access for free users
DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
item.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 is a large-scale mixture-of-experts model from DeepSeek. $0.435 per million input tokens, $0.87 per million output tokens. 1,048,576 token context window, maximum output of 384,000 tokens. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Software development with AI is starting to feel like cooking steak
item.description: Why AI can make software development faster without replacing the judgment and understanding needed to build consistently good software. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: How Artificial Intelligence Disrupts Engineering Progression
item.description: AI is disrupting career progression by eliminating the learning opportunities at each rung while simultaneously enabling people to perform above their experience level, Alasdair Allan explained in his talk Engineering Progression When AI… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Spotify Builds External Index to Enable Low Latency Point Queries on Its Data Lake
item.description: Spotify introduced external indexing architecture for Apache Parquet data lakes that enables low-latency point queries without replicating datasets into operational databases. (1 source: infoq)
